route.basis: The generic ALPO bachelor combines pedagogical science with primary teaching. Onderwijs most directly represents this defining identity through educational quality and curriculum design. It is selected independently of UCR fit; the formal source confirms all four specialisations and the corresponding professional-skills choices.

formalConditions.specialisation: Choose one of four8EC specialisations; Onderwijs uses the two named4EC courses.
formalConditions.professionalSkills3: Onderwijs & Pedagogiek always accessible irrespective of specialisation; Orthopedagogiek requires the matching third-year specialisation. Art8.2 also requires BeroepsvaardighedenALPO and pre-enrolment.
formalConditions.skillsAndThesis: Academic-skills1 before2; academic-skills2 before thesis; pre-enrolment required. The ordinary pathway completes earlier-year requirements.
formalConditions.BSA: RU24of34year1EC; HAN current official page describes nonbinding PSA. Do not claim two binding thresholds.
formalConditions.freeChoice: No open elective space for ALPO (Art9.5).
formalConditions.noncredit: Current year1 page lists RADAr academic Dutch at0EC; this is not added to credit total.

conflictResolution: Appendix5 repeats the identical PWB3370 collaboration code. Count once, as explicitly listed once on official year4 page and required by the stated30EC year4/120EC course total. This is a duplicated line, not a second distinct requirement. OER formal semester labels control formal sequence; webpage period displays are indicative. No hidden obsolete edition was used.
discoveryStoppingReason: Current official programme, four year pages, HAN programme, after-study page and formal OER adequately establish complete identity/credits/route/choices/progression and all38linked interests. No individual Osiris credit corroboration is needed.
